study.question: Does the prior supplied-versus-global-canonical AUC gap require ordering within retained blocks or ordering of fully occupied blocks, or can it be explained by preservation of contiguous block membership?
study.hypothesis: Observation: supplied unchanged click AUC0.6685268680 versus global canonical forward0.6659442302; supplied reverse0.6683840769 versus global canonical reverse0.6660154869, at identical32192421 learned parameters. Reversal retaining most local neighborhoods nearly preserves quality, whereas global ID sorting changes neighborhood membership and loses about0.0024-0.0026 AUC. A provisional explanation is useful content co-occurrence inside the supplied ten-slot groups rather than a strong need for within-group or between-full-group order. A content-canonical ordering of events inside their ORIGINAL ten-slot groups, followed independently by content-canonical ordering of completely valid groups, should preserve much of the supplied model quality without restoring the supplied ranks. This is an attribution study, not a new architecture, established mechanism or novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text Eq3/lines268-283 gives target-conditioned unnormalized weighted pooling and reports an unsuccessful LSTM experiment in its own setting. We retain the adapted scorer, block compression and task-conditioned nonlinear context/history branch, and test group-preserving order interventions. The external negative sequence result is not local evidence.

Pinned90bb99a source lines176-200 flattens full history before tokenization. No flattening/tokenizer is adopted. Unlike global flattening or global canonical sorting, the new treatment retains original block membership. Original UniMixer paper content unavailable; priority and exact reproduction claims unverified.

Pinned source lines113-159 pools history before feature/task tokens. No heterogeneous interaction block adopted; inherited strongest joint model is held fixed. Original HiFormer full paper is unavailable; benchmark source inspection supports only this implementation-level comparison.

Read source _history_layout: complete-event lexicographic sorting transports every field and mask but changes original ten-slot neighborhoods. The new factorial preserves those neighborhoods and moves only fully occupied groups, isolating a consequential unresolved cause of its validation regression.

inherited_components: Entire g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer learned architecture and initialization, reproduced by g1-r0054-supplied_unchanged
action-aware unnormalized scorer; uniform/feedback compression; folded rotated Dice support, native running states and auxiliary stop-gradient paths
five target-match/ordinal summaries, task residual adapters and blockwise nonlinear product fusion
complete-event canonical keys include all item fields, action and all four eligibility masks; target and invalid slots preserved
study.proposed_difference: Add a nonlearned pre-embedding layout. First lexicographically rank valid complete event tuples (no hash collisions or position tie-breakers); identical tuples receive identical dense content ranks. Use ranks to derive canonical valid-event order separately in each original ten-slot block. Independently sort completely valid blocks lexicographically by their sorted ten content ranks, a multiset key independent of original within-block order; all partial and empty blocks stay at their original locations. Cross within_block_order=supplied/canonical and whole_block_order=supplied/canonical. All four cells calculate identical index candidates and gather all fields/masks; only selected sources differ. No new parameters or information. Candidate both-canonical removes these two order choices while retaining original group membership. It is NOT invariant to permutations that change group membership, validity patterns or the position of the partial block; no assertion of a fully order-invariant model. Equal full-block multisets are tie-broken by their original ordered content tuple (no original block index); this ensures blocks-only invariance even when two multisets match but their member order differs. After within-block canonicalization those tied groups are identical, so the secondary key cannot leak their old order.
predictions: Primary: both-canonical has click AUC within0.0005 of identity-layout control and exceeds existing global canonical forward by at least0.0015. These are prospective practical thresholds, not statistical significance cutoffs.

Within-only and blocks-only contrasts each have absolute AUC loss below0.0005 if group contents rather than tested order scales explain most of the gap. Report interaction A11-A10-A01+A00 even when null or negative.

Full-block canonical treatment is invariant to permutations of completely valid blocks; both-canonical is invariant jointly to valid-event permutations within original blocks and permutations of completely valid blocks, conditional on fixed partial-block/padding support. Within-only is invariant only to within-original-block permutations.

Parameter count must remain32192421 (31793216 embedding,399205 dense); identity-cell outputs/updates/state must match the unchanged imported source. Cost includes every canonicalization operation; no speed advantage is predicted.
falsifiers: Failure of complete event/mask alignment, padding/target preservation, exact source-group membership, expected limited invariance, equal learned state or identity bridge invalidates interpretation and must be fixed before host training.

Reproducible loss above0.0005 for within-only with block order retained weakens the group-membership-only explanation and motivates separating ordinal moments from rotated Dice support; it does not prove chronology itself is causal.

Reproducible loss above0.0005 for blocks-only with within-group order retained weakens the claim that original full-block order is dispensable. A substantial factorial interaction prevents adding main effects as independent explanations.

If both-canonical is no better than global canonical within0.0005 despite valid controls, preservation of original group membership does not rescue the tested implementation. One seed remains preliminary; no sequence-mechanism refutation or confirmation.
alternative_explanations: ID-based content canonicalization changes feature scaling, moment content, rotated support assignments and optimization under the one-epoch host recipe; those are mediators or residual explanations, not proof of intrinsic chronological information.

Partial-block position, validity pattern, original group membership and history truncation remain supplied-order traces; preserving quality would only show dispensability of the two tested order choices.

Rotated support depends on within-block order during training; evaluation-only invariance or prediction-time shuffles do not identify its optimization effect. Treatments run during both training and validation.
Sequential trial resource drift, finite precision and seed variation can imitate small effects; paired repetitions and measured costs remain necessary.

DIN has higher auxiliary AUCs than every supplied joint trajectory; click gains do not establish a four-task improvement. All trajectories succeeded technically; canonical losses are scientific counterevidence, not execution failures. No inaccessible abandoned runs are inferred.
